title: Sturm-Liouville problems with a boundary condition depending linearly on an eigenparameter
summary: This paper studies a Sturm--Liouville boundary value problem in which one of the boundary conditions depends linearly on the spectral parameter. The differential equation is considered on the interval $(0,1)$ with a classical boundary condition at one endpoint and an eigenparameter--dependent boundary condition at the other. Explicit formulas for the inner products and norms of the root functions are obtained.
